preconditions.description: Number of cities n is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s <= n and 1 <= t <= n and s != t for s, t in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The minimum number of road inversions is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= capital <= n for capital in capitals)
postconditions.description: All possible capitals are within the range [1, n].
The list of possible capitals is sorted in increasing order.

postconditions.expression: all(min_inversions <= count_inversions(capital) for capital in capitals)
postconditions.description: The minimum number of inversions is less than or equal to the number of inversions required for each possible capital.
